title: L-028 Completion: Parser-Phrasing Alignment + Prompt Tightening
author: Student (Raphael Forge)
defect_statement: L-028 fallback parser is wired and invoked (conclusion_adapters.py:1563-1570) and model_inference evidence flows (10/10 samples, live model deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash-0731), yet 0/10 re-audit samples produce fallback-sourced typed predicates. Measured causes: (a) the model's free-text claim phrasing 'Host 10.0.248.10 runs an Apache service on port 80.' matches no fallback pattern (FALLBACK 5 requires 'port N open|tcp|udp'); (b) the model returns structured_conclusion {} because the prompt's escape hatch ('If you cannot determine any structured conclusion, use: {}') permits it and the prompt never requires has_service/service_type for service_identification claims. Proven: real _parse_fallback_heuristic on real model phrasing -> 0 claims; proposed pattern -> ('Apache', '80').
scope: Two frozen-src files, two minimal edits each. No cognitive-loop logic changes.

fix_1.change_a: Add second pattern for 'on port N' phrasing
fix_1.after:
port_matches = _re.findall(r'port\s+(\d+)\s+(?:open|tcp|udp)', claim_lower)
            if not port_matches:
                # Model phrasing: 'runs an Apache service on port 80.' / 'on port 443'
                port_matches = _re.findall(
                    r'(?:runs?\s+an?\s+[\w-]+\s+service\s+)?on\s+port\s+(\d+)', claim_lower)
fix_1.change_b: Extend svc_type mapping so service names map to types
fix_1.before:
if 'http' in claim_lower or 'web' in claim_lower:
                    svc_type = "http"
fix_1.after:
if 'http' in claim_lower or 'web' in claim_lower or 'apache' in claim_lower \
                        or 'nginx' in claim_lower or 'tomcat' in claim_lower:
                    svc_type = "http"
fix_1.rationale: Closes the exact phrasing gap proven in forge/prove_parser_gap.py. Extracts only what the LLM explicitly stated ('Apache service on port 80'). No invention: type inferred from the service name the model itself wrote.
fix_1.no_hallucination_check: Pattern requires the port number to be present in the LLM's own claim text; svc_type only derived from service names present in the same claim.

fix_2.change_a: Remove duplicated rule lines (383-384 duplicate 394-395; duplicate 'cve' line 391) and renumber rules 1-7
fix_2.before: Rules 1-5 with duplication: '4. If none of the categories apply...' twice, two rule-5s, duplicate '"cve": string or null'
fix_2.change_b: Replace the {} escape hatch with a requirement + guard
fix_2.before:
"5. If you cannot determine any structured conclusion, use:\n"
    '   "structured_conclusion": {}\n'
fix_2.after:
"5. structured_conclusion is REQUIRED and must contain every predicate
"
    "   you can determine from evidence. Leave a predicate null only when
"
    "   the evidence does not support it. Never invent values not in evidence.
"
    "6. If your claim identifies a service (Apache, nginx, SSH, ...) and a port,
"
    "   you MUST populate has_service with {"port": N, "type": "http"/"ssh"/...}
"
    "   and set service_type to the service name's type.
"
    "7. If version strings (e.g., Apache/2.4.50) appear in evidence, you MUST
"
    "   populate version. If CVE references appear, you MUST populate cve.
"
    "   Otherwise set them to null.
"
fix_2.rationale: Removes the permission to emit {} while preserving the no-hallucination constraint (rule 5 keeps 'never invent'). Makes the L-028 mandated predicates a hard requirement whenever evidence supports them.
fix_2.risk: Model compliance on -0731 snapshot unknown until re-tested; the fallback parser (Fix 1) remains the safety net for free-text extraction.

fix_3.rationale: Version-bearing evidence (syn_scan method='all') is a candidate-generation behavior change affecting ALL llm_only templates. Recommend adjudicating separately AFTER Fix 1+2 gate result. If Fix 2 causes the model to extract versions that ARE present in evidence, Fix 3 may be unnecessary for the 10-sample gate (contradiction template evidence currently lacks version strings entirely, so version predicates will still be 0 — gate measures has_service/service_type availability).

verification_plan.step_1: Extend forge/verify_l028_fix.py unit test: real model phrasing 'Host 10.0.248.10 runs an Apache service on port 80.' must yield has_service {port: 80, type: http} via REAL _parse_fallback_heuristic (no src change to test yet — simulate expected post-fix behavior).
verification_plan.step_2: Apply Fix 1+2 via forge/patch script; compile check; tracked suite 127/127 must stay green; .forge_backup snapshots created.
verification_plan.step_3: Re-run 10-sample re-audit (forge/verify_l028.py, live -0731, key rotation A/B) -> gate >= 8/10 fallback-sourced typed predicates; halt if >= 2/10 MECHANICAL.
verification_plan.step_4: If gate passes: per Option A directive, proceed to 1,200-row holdout.
verification_plan.step_5: Report raw telemetry (L028_VERIFICATION.json v4) with the result — no claim without JSONL/JSON telemetry (Strike 2 rule).

blast_radius: Low. Parser edits are additive regex branches inside an existing except-guarded block; prompt edits alter only the system prompt string. No changes to cognitive loop, broker, environment, or evidence pipeline. Tracked tests verify no regression (127/127).
requested_ruling: Approve Fix 1 + Fix 2 as specified. Defer Fix 3. Rule on the frozen EOL model default (semantic_inference.py:281, ablation_runner.py:844-852) — recommend updating default model_id to deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash-0731 and documenting .env key sourcing, since the frozen default is 410-EOL since 2026-08-07 and the frozen hardcoded key cannot access the catalog.
